[Source 1 — www.aljazeera.com (Bias: Center / State-Funded International)] (URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress?traffic_source=rss):
Why did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress?

Huang has stepped down amid allegations of extramarital affairs and Chinese espionage.

[Source 2 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261112-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-after-mounting-scandals):
Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after mounting scandals

Jensen Huang, long considered the face of the AI revolution, has resigned as Nvidia's President, CEO and board member as sandals over his romantic affairs wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the company's market value in a matter of days. US lawmakers signal they'll likely push for tighter export restrictions for AI chips. Meanwhile, the rapid buildout of AI data centre is sparking anger and worries among French communities.

[Source 3 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-replacement):
Who could replace the departed Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO?

Chief financial officer Colette Kress to take over on interim basis but other names are in mix to be permanent successorThe hunt is on for a new Nvidia CEO. It comes after a whirlwind week, which saw the company head and co-founder, Jensen Huang, resign amid multiple allegations of extramarital affairs, including one that involved an alleged Chinese spy and two with company employees.Nvidia immediately named Colette Kress, the company’s chief financial officer, as the interim CEO. It’s possible she could stay on permanently, but the company could also name another candidate for the full-time role. Names that have been floated include Ian Buck, who manages Nvidia’s AI hardware and software products, and Rene Haas, a former Nvidia employee and the current CEO of Arm Holdings, a UK-based chipmaker.
